gotchas: Product pages are on www.samsung.com/us while the cart and the checkout are on shop.samsung.com/us. The checkout is an Angular Material app whose input ids are random, so address fields by name and formcontrolname.

A consent modal intercepts every click on both hosts. Click Accept All once with a generous timeout: the node stays in the document but stops intercepting, and the cookie carries across to the shop host. Escape did not dismiss it, and pressing Enter on a control works even while it is up.

Use the accessories category listing without a sort parameter, because adding one renders no results. Product cards link as a[href*='-sku-'], and older accessory URL shapes redirect back to the listing.

A successful add navigates to the cart on its own. Through the proxy the add click was refused in two of four runs and pressing Enter on #continue_btn always worked but did not always navigate, so open the cart URL if a.cart-item__link counts 0 after about 10 seconds.

Three continue-to-checkout buttons exist, one visible per breakpoint. Below about 1100 pixels wide the button opens an express-checkout modal whose own button has to be clicked, while at a desktop width it goes straight through, so record the selector per breakpoint.
Guest checkout needs the email first: the button is inert until the guest email field is filled.

On the delivery step click Enter address manually before filling the address. The state control fills itself from the postal code, so validate that with a postal code outside the one used here, and fall back to opening the select and picking the matching option.

On the payment step click the Pay with card panel header to expand it. The card fields are inside a same-origin srcdoc iframe, iframe.cc-iframe, with number, expiry and CVV addressed by formcontrolname.

Give each action 20 to 30 seconds, because a short timeout can expire before the click is even tried. Twice a click reported a timeout after the page had already advanced, so re-check state by count before retrying.
notes: Driven locally and through the Agent Vault proxy in September 2026 from the product page to the card frame: add to cart, the cart on shop.samsung.com, the express-checkout modal, the guest email and Guest checkout, the delivery form with the address typed manually, Continue to Payment, then the Pay with card panel and the card number, expiry and CVV inputs inside the payment frame, each counting 1. The card was not filled, so the status is unverified.
